scenes.heading: Environment & Config Management (12-Factor)
scenes.subheading: Separate config from code the right way
scenes.narration: The twelve-factor methodology teaches us to keep configuration strictly separate from application code.

scenes.heading: Config principles
bullets: Store config in the environment, not the code
Keep one codebase deployed to many environments
Never commit secrets to version control
Make the same image run in dev, staging, and prod
scenes.narration: Configuration such as connection strings and credentials belongs in the environment, not baked into your code. A single codebase should deploy unchanged to many environments. Secrets must never be committed to version control. And the same built image should run in development, staging, and production, differing only by injected configuration.

scenes.heading: Config from the environment
scenes.code:
# Environment variables define the connection
export DB_HOST=warehouse.prod.internal
export DB_PORT=5432
export DB_USER=etl_service

# The app reads them at runtime, never hardcoded
python -c "import os; print(os.environ['DB_HOST'])"
scenes.narration: Here the database connection details are supplied entirely through environment variables. The application reads them at runtime rather than hardcoding any value, which means the exact same code can point at a development database or a production warehouse simply by changing what the environment provides.

scenes.heading: Hardcoded vs externalized config
scenes.narration: When configuration is hardcoded, every setting change forces a rebuild and secrets inevitably leak into version control. When configuration is externalized, you inject it at runtime, change settings without rebuilding, and keep secrets safely out of your source code.

scenes.text: Build the image once, configure it per environment, and manage secrets through a dedicated secrets store.
scenes.narration: The guiding rule is to build the image once, configure it per environment through variables, and hand secret management off to a dedicated secrets store.
